changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A practice's current revision also records its visual and guide, so the projection check compares them.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_practice_current_revision_projection() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM practice practice JOIN practice_revision revision ON revision.id = practice.current_revision_id AND revision.practice_id = practice.id LEFT JOIN practice_group practice_group ON practice_group.id = practice.practice_group_id WHERE practice.id = NEW.id AND revision.slug = practice.slug AND revision.name = practice.name AND revision.applies_to = practice.applies_to AND revision.signals = practice.signals AND revision.evidence_requirements = practice.evidence_requirements AND revision.review_when = practice.review_when AND revision.subject = practice.subject AND revision.precondition IS NOT DISTINCT FROM practice.precondition AND revision.criteria = practice.criteria AND revision.precompute_script IS NOT DISTINCT FROM practice.precompute_script AND revision.automated_review_policy = practice.automated_review_policy AND revision.delivery_behavior = practice.delivery_behavior AND revision.why_it_matters IS NOT DISTINCT FROM practice.why_it_matters AND revision.what_good_looks_like IS NOT DISTINCT FROM practice.what_good_looks_like AND revision.visual IS NOT DISTINCT FROM practice.visual AND revision.guide IS NOT DISTINCT FROM practice.guide AND revision.group_slug IS NOT DISTINCT FROM practice_group.slug ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'practice current revision does not match its current projection' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF; RETURN NULL; END; $$;
